digest.component_or_area: ticket summary resolution and agent guidance
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing agents to default to the locally salient caller-supplied prefix
The summary schema, library, CLI, and MCP contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making four-character prefixes the most available identifier for agents to copy
Agent guidance lacks an affirmative rule to select aliases for tracker commands after discovery and to reserve canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts

Adding the resolved alias as an additive field to summary results while preserving ticket_id echo semantics and fail-closed ambiguous-prefix behavior causes agents to select aliases 25/25 times instead of four-character prefixes
